command.short: Allocate and plan Tailscale address space.
command.long:
Allocate and plan Tailscale address space.

Results go to stdout: human text on a terminal, one JSON document otherwise.
--format or AGENT_MODE selects the format. A failure is one JSON error object
on stderr, with operational diagnostics. Registry commands use a
comment-preserving HuJSON file or a SQLite database, selected by --registry
and --tailnet.

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  a valid operation was refused (for example, a registry collision or
     a calc split producing too many subnets to materialize), or check/check-policy found drift
  2  invalid invocation, incomplete comparison, unreadable input, or output failure
command.example:
tsipam site-id reserve 1 hq-vpc
  tsipam subnet reserve 10.0.0.0/24 hq-vpc
  tsipam service reserve 100.100.100.8 dashboard
  tsipam port reserve 41642 branch-fw01 --site branch-office
  tsipam site-id list -format json
  tsipam devices list -verbose
  tsipam -schema

commands.short: Check authored ipsets against subnet reservations; exit 1 on drift.
commands.long:
Compare every ipset definition in a local HuJSON policy with reserved subnet pools.

Reads local files only; no API credentials, live collection, or file changes.
Supports addresses, CIDRs, ranges, host: aliases, nested ipset: references, and ordered add/remove.
Autogroups (including autogroup:internet) and dynamic selectors are unsupported and cause exit 2.
Each effective CIDR needs one containing reservation; adjacent pools do not combine.
A pool is referenced by any overlapping effective CIDR, even in an unused ipset definition.
ACL/grant reachability and other allocation kinds are outside this check.
Expansion is limited to 128 nesting levels and 65536 prefixes across definitions.
Exits 0 for consistency, 1 for drift, or 2 for incomplete input or output errors.
--sanitize identity or strict redacts ipset names, CIDRs, sites, and registry aliases.

#### macOS:

	tsipam completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/tsipam

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

stdin and stdout, and ends it by closing stdin. It opens no network listener, and logs
go to stderr. The client gets the caller's own authority: it can read any registry or
policy file the caller can, and write registries. A release needs yes in that call.

commands.short: List the registry's audit events, newest first (requires the sqlite backend).
commands.long:
List the registry's audit events, newest first (requires the sqlite backend).

Every reservation a command creates, changes, or removes in a sqlite:// registry is
recorded with its value before and after. Events are never edited or deleted.
A file registry keeps no history here; its history lives in version control.
Human output is one tab-separated line per event: time, action, kind, key, site,
before, after, actor. A column with no value is "-"; a local command has no actor.
